credits.title: FING!
credits.overview: Myrtle's parents will do anything to make her happy, even track down a strange creature in a remote jungle. But when a greedy wildlife park owner takes the rare Fing, the family must pull off a daring rescue to save their magical friend.

credits.title: Primitive War
credits.overview: During the Vietnam War, a recon unit ventures to an isolated jungle valley to uncover the fate of a missing platoon. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives against an unexpected enemy — prehistoric dinosaurs.
